accepted.s: The Strategic Partnership model was added to the Defence Procurement Procedure in which year?
accepted.x: The Strategic Partnership model was added to the Defence Procurement Procedure in 2017.
accepted.tq: Use the precise year associated with the policy provision.
accepted.sec: Defence industry partnerships - Strategic Partnership model, OEM teaming, TDF

accepted.s: Under the Strategic Partnership model, selected Indian private firms are expected to team up with foreign OEMs primarily to:
o: Restrict defence production to public sector undertakings
Import complete defence platforms without domestic production
Undertake only maintenance of civilian aircraft
Build major defence platforms in India
accepted.x: The model enables selected Indian private firms to partner with foreign original equipment manufacturers to build major platforms in India.
accepted.tq: Identify the practical purpose of the policy rather than its institutional label.
accepted.sec: Defence industry partnerships - Strategic Partnership model, OEM teaming, TDF

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT one of the four segments covered under the Strategic Partnership model?
accepted.x: The four segments are fighter aircraft, helicopters, submarines and armoured vehicles or main battle tanks. Unmanned agricultural drones are not included in this list.
accepted.tq: Find the item outside the stated four-part classification.
accepted.sec: Defence industry partnerships - Strategic Partnership model, OEM teaming, TDF

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the L&T–Navantia partnership:
1. L&T and Navantia signed a Teaming Agreement in July 2023.
2. The agreement was signed in New Delhi.
3. The agreement was intended to support a bid for the P-75(I) submarines.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. L&T and Spain's Navantia signed the agreement in New Delhi in July 2023 to bid for the P-75(I) submarine programme.
accepted.tq: Verify the date, place and purpose separately before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Defence industry partnerships - Strategic Partnership model, OEM teaming, TDF

accepted.s: The K9 Vajra-T self-propelled gun emerged from defence-industrial cooperation between India and:
accepted.x: The K9 Vajra-T self-propelled gun emerged from India–South Korea cooperation under the 2020 Roadmap for Defence Industries Cooperation.
accepted.tq: Match the defence platform with the country of cooperation.
accepted.sec: Defence industry partnerships - Strategic Partnership model, OEM teaming, TDF

accepted.s:
Arrange the following India–South Korea defence-cooperation milestones in chronological order:
A. Special Strategic Partnership
B. Memorandum of Understanding
C. Roadmap for Defence Industries Cooperation
D. K9 Vajra-T as an outcome of cooperation
accepted.x: The sequence is the 2005 Memorandum of Understanding, the 2015 Special Strategic Partnership, the 2020 Roadmap, and subsequently the K9 Vajra-T outcome.
accepted.tq: Fix the dated milestones first and place the resulting platform after the cooperation framework.

o: GTRE is developing it from the Kaveri engine
GTRE is developing it from the K9 Vajra-T engine

Which of the following were features of VIMARSH 2026?
1. Direct funding and incubation for MSMEs and start-ups
2. Access to DRDO test facilities
3. Secure sharing of DRDO software source code with licensed firms
4. Transfer of nine licensing agreements to thirteen partners

accepted.s: The Agnishodh research cell is associated with:
o: The Indian Army at IIT Madras
The Indian Air Force at IISc Bengaluru
The Indian Navy at IIT Delhi
accepted.x: Agnishodh is the Indian Army's research cell at IIT Madras and links Army requirements with academic research and development.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among closely related military–academic research arrangements.
accepted.sec: Military research cells at academic institutions

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. There are 15 DIA-CoEs at IITs, IISc and central universities.
2. JCBCAT is associated with Jadavpur University.
3. Agnishodh links Indian Army needs to academic R&D.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The academic links include 15 DIA-CoEs, JCBCAT at Jadavpur University and the Army's Agnishodh cell at IIT Madras.
accepted.tq: Combine the institutional count, location and functional role without swapping the organisations.

Ten-year roadmap for global defence partnerships

accepted.s:
Which of the following are pillars of RAKSHA?
1. Strategic partnerships
2. Capacity building
3. Indigenous exports
4. Maritime security as a net security provider in the Indian Ocean Region
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four listed elements are pillars of RAKSHA: strategic partnerships, capacity building, indigenous exports and maritime security linked to India's net security-provider role in the IOR.
accepted.tq: Test the complete set of pillars rather than selecting only the familiar policy terms.

accepted.s: Which one of the following platforms is correctly classified as a licence-built Russian design produced in India?
accepted.x: The Su-30MKI is a Russian-design fighter licence-built by HAL at Nashik. ATAGS, Tejas and Arjun are indigenous designs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish licence production from indigenous design and development.

accepted.s: The T-90 'Bhishma' is licence-built at:
accepted.x: The T-90 'Bhishma' is a licence-built Russian main battle tank produced at the Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi.
accepted.tq: Match the platform with its Indian production facility.

accepted.s: Which of the following sets consists entirely of indigenous designs?
o: ATAGS, Arjun, Tejas, Akash and Pinaka
accepted.x: ATAGS, Arjun, Tejas, Akash and Pinaka are identified as indigenous designs. Su-30MKI and T-90 are licence-built, while Akula and F-35 are not made in India.
accepted.tq: Classify every item before accepting an all-inclusive option.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. LCA Tejas — ADA design, HAL
2. HTT-40 — HAL
3. Dhruv ALH — HAL
4. Arjun — DRDO
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. LCA Tejas is an ADA design produced by HAL; HTT-40 and Dhruv ALH are associated with HAL, while Arjun is associated with DRDO.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure maker-platform pairs and verify the remaining pairs systematically.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Akashteer — automated air-defence control system — BEL with the Army
Swathi WLR — licence-built Russian fighter — HAL Nashik
T-90 Bhishma — indigenous Indian tank — DRDO-CVRDE
accepted.x: Akashteer is an automated air-defence control system associated with BEL and the Army. The other pairs incorrectly classify or identify the listed platforms.
accepted.tq: Use the platform's function to expose swapped maker and category details.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Arjun — Russian-design tank licence-built at Avadi
accepted.x: Arjun is an indigenous main battle tank design associated with DRDO; it is not a Russian-design tank licence-built at Avadi. The other three pairs are correct.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong designer-origin relationship rather than merely identifying a foreign platform.
